name: ml-collab-codec
description: Schema-defined documents, readable source, agent editing, and structural/text OT with collaborative undo.

scripts.check:dev: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run deadcode && bun run test
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run deadcode && bun run build && bun run test && bun run acceptance:check && bun run typecheck:core
scripts.build: bun run clean && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target browser --format esm --sourcemap=external && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test:property: PROPERTY_BUDGET=2000 PROPERTY_STEPS=120 bun test tests/unit/transform-properties.test.ts tests/acceptance/r-simulation.test.ts tests/acceptance/q.test.ts --timeout 600000
